obraz: The stuck window gives when you lean into the frame with both hands.
proc: Resistance gives way to bodily force applied with both hands.
Resistance gives way to bodily force applied fully.

obraz: You answer in the new language before you have time to translate the question.
proc: The answer comes from under the surface before it can be reasoned out.
The response comes from below before conscious explanation.

obraz: After days of practising alone, the first sentence comes out ready.
proc: Unseen work alone completes itself and emerges ready.
Hidden work completes itself and comes out ready.

obraz: You hold the door, and the stranger behind you holds the next one for you.
proc: A courtesy given is received and returned between two people.
A gesture given and one received back, uncounted.

obraz: You refuse the promotion that rests on your colleague's work.
proc: Taking the right side knowingly at the cost of a promotion.
Taking the right side knowingly at a personal cost.

obraz: You have typed the angry reply, and your thumb stops above the send button.
proc: A move is stopped just before it is made.
A move is halted right before it is made.

obraz: The small monthly payments finally cover the cost of the course.
proc: Small steps over time finally add up to a result.
Small acts over a long time finally show as a result.

obraz: You follow your grandmother's recipe card and add the change your family made.
proc: A handed-down thing is carried on with the family's own change.
An inherited way is carried on with a choice of what to keep.

obraz: Halfway through the dishes a song comes on, and you both sing along.
proc: Shared joy in the middle of a chore.
Shared joy in the middle of a chore.

obraz: The child struggles with the zip, and you wait while they try again.
proc: A fragile attempt is given room rather than forced.
A fragile attempt is given room rather than forced.

obraz: You start to interrupt, see the other has not finished, and close your mouth.
proc: An interruption is stopped at the threshold after seeing what the rush would miss.
A move is stopped at the threshold just before it is made.

obraz: A gust turns the umbrella inside out, and you push it back into shape.
proc: An outside force breaks the shape of something that looked solid.
An outside gust bends the umbrella, but it goes back into shape rather than breaking.

obraz: The old key still opens the shed at your parents' house.
proc: Returning to the parental place where the old thing still fits.
A return to the inherited place that still admits you.

obraz: The train is late again, and you two start rating the vending-machine snacks.
proc: Two people find lightness together in the middle of a delay.
Shared lightness in the middle of a delay, not a reward.

obraz: The child ties the lace wrong, and your hand stays in your pocket.
proc: The helper holds back so the small beginner can grow.
A fragile beginning is given room instead of being forced.

obraz: You reach to post the photo, then notice someone in it who never agreed.
proc: A stop just before posting shows what the rush would have missed.
A move is stopped just before it is made and the stop shows what the rush missed.

obraz: The old wooden chair creaks under your weight, bends a little, and holds.
proc: It bends under strain and does not break.
It bends under strain and does not break.

obraz: You mend your coat on the sewing machine your mother taught you to use.
proc: A skill and tool handed down by the mother is carried on.
A handed-down skill and tool carried on.

obraz: The birthday cake leans, and the child asks for the piece sliding off.
proc: The imperfect moment turns light and joyful instead of failing.
A mishap turns into lightness and delight in the middle of things.

obraz: The seedling droops in its new pot, then opens one fresh leaf toward the window.
proc: Fragile new life starts growing in its new room.
Fragile new life given room starts to grow.

obraz: One person says, "I thought I was the only one," and the table goes quiet.
proc: Someone recognises themselves among the others.
A person recognises themselves among others at the table.

obraz: The phone case splits when it hits the floor, and the screen beneath is whole.
proc: A blow breaks one thing and shows what held.
A sudden blow breaks one thing and shows what held.

obraz: You turn the map on your phone, and the street falls into place.
proc: A turn after which the same street looks different and makes sense.
An orientation shift lets you see where you stand.

obraz: The flight is cancelled at the gate, and the group chat fills with new plans.
proc: An outside event breaks the plan and something new follows.
An outside event breaks the plan and people regroup after it.

obraz: On the tandem the wobble stops when both riders settle into one pace.
proc: Progress comes when two settle into one common pace.
Progress comes when two find a common rhythm.

obraz: You say the decision out loud, and it suddenly sounds different.
proc: Speaking it aloud changes what the thing means.
Speech spoken aloud changes what the thing means.

obraz: A parcel arrives with no sender, and the label gives no clue what is inside.
proc: Something exists inside but is not yet shown or known.
Something exists inside but is not yet known.

obraz: One ordinary sentence from its sender makes you read the whole message differently.
proc: One arriving sentence changes the meaning of the rest.
A sentence arrives and gives the whole message a new meaning.

obraz: A power cut ends the video call and takes the unsaved slide with it.
proc: An uninvited outside force cuts things off and takes something with it.
An outside force breaks the plan and takes something with it.

obraz: Two carry a long mirror through the doorway: one pauses, the other turns.
proc: Two move one load by adjusting to each other.
Two people coordinate their moves to get one object through.

obraz: One sentence in the voice message tells you the plan has changed.
proc: A spoken sentence arrives and changes the situation.
A spoken word arrives and changes the situation.

obraz: A voice memo is saved as "Untitled", and you cannot recall what you said.
proc: No name and no recalled content - unmarked.
No name and no recalled meaning attached to the thing.

obraz: At dawn the street that felt strange in the dark is the one you know.
proc: Dark turns to light and the same street looks different.
The turn from dark to light makes the same place look different.

obraz: After the burst pipe the new ceiling is down, and the old counter still stands.
proc: A burst from outside destroys and shows what is gone and what held.
An uninvited force breaks something and shows what held.

obraz: Two people work the long saw in turn, and the blade moves cleanly.
proc: Two alternate in rhythm without forcing and the work moves.
Two move in alternating rhythm, neither forcing the other.

obraz: The path across the grass is on no plan; it is where everyone actually walks.
proc: A road made by people actually walking it.
A road made only by people walking it.

obraz: The result is ready in the app, but the notification shows no number.
proc: The result exists but is not yet shown.
The thing exists but is not yet shown.

obraz: A new document is open, and the first line is still yours to choose.
proc: An open unwritten space waiting for its first mark.
An open space where nothing has been written yet.

obraz: The phone is at two per cent, and you send the one message that matters.
proc: Scarcity forces the choice of what truly matters.
Scarcity forces the choice of the one thing truly needed.

obraz: You hear your own phrase come out of a friend's mouth and learn how it sounds.
proc: One hears oneself through another person as in a mirror.
You hear yourself mirrored in another person.

obraz: On the long drive you miss your turning because the road was so easy to follow.
proc: The easy road carries one past where one meant to go.
The rhythm of the road carries you past where you meant to go.

obraz: The door opens on its chain, just far enough to see who is knocking.
proc: A guard that opens enough to look but does not let everything in.
A guarded opening that watches without letting everything in.

obraz: The form asks for a detail it never explains, and you leave the box blank.
proc: You withhold something from an unexplained request rather than let it in.
An unexplained space is left unmarked.

obraz: One seat is left on the last bus, and it goes to the person on crutches.
proc: One scarce seat goes where the need is real.
Scarcity shows who truly needs the one thing left.

obraz: A friend calls you patient, and you have never thought of yourself that way.
proc: You see yourself through another's eyes for the first time.
You see yourself through another person's view of you.

obraz: A few lengths in, your strokes find a rhythm you no longer count.
proc: Rhythm is found only by moving, stroke after stroke.
A rhythm is found only by moving, stroke after stroke.

obraz: You share your location with your family and not with the group chat.
proc: Selective openness: some are let in, others not.
Selective openness: some are let in, others not.

obraz: The new flat has one empty wall, and you have not decided what belongs there.
proc: An empty space where nothing has been decided or written yet.
An open, unmarked space where nothing has been decided yet.

obraz: Before the water is shut off you fill one bottle.
proc: Coming lack reduces the act to the one thing needed.
Coming lack narrows action to what is needed.

obraz: A friend copies the way you tap your foot, and you never knew you did it.
proc: Another person mirrors a habit you did not know you had.
You see yourself through another person as in a mirror.

obraz: Your phone torch finds the dropped key in the dark under the seat.
proc: A small light reveals what was there in the dark.
A small light reveals what was there in the dark.

obraz: You mute the work chat overnight and leave family calls switched on.
proc: A guard that shuts out one channel and stays open to another.
A guard that stays open but does not let everything in.

obraz: The food you were saving for a special day is past its date.
proc: Value kept standing unused has lost its worth.
Value kept standing instead of used loses its worth.

obraz: The waterfall has become a wall of ice, its last streams held against the rock.
proc: Moving water is stopped and held as it is.
Flowing water stopped and held as it is.

obraz: Your foot moves to the brake before you have named what is wrong.
proc: Something is sensed and acted on before it can be explained.
The body senses the danger before it can be named.

obraz: You change the hallway bulb and see a crack in the ceiling.
proc: New light shows a crack that was there all along.
A small light reveals something that was there all along.

obraz: The fog lifts, and the trail marker you were walking toward appears.
proc: The obscurity lifts and what was hidden ahead becomes visible.
Clearing light shows where one stands and where one is heading.

obraz: The battery you never use is flat on the day you need it.
proc: What was left unused has lost its strength.
What is not used loses its strength.

obraz: A chain of bubbles rises through the dark water, then stops beneath the clear ice.
proc: Rising movement is stopped and held in view under the ice.
Something moves under the surface of dark water.

obraz: You lower your voice when your friend goes quiet, before either of you knows why.
proc: A response to something sensed before either can explain it.
Something is sensed and acted on before anyone can explain it.

obraz: The idea comes mid-walk, and you stop to record it before it goes.
proc: A small spark appears and must be tended before it goes out.
A small spark appears and must be caught and fed before it goes out.

obraz: After the power cut the apartment block lights up window by window.
proc: Darkness turns to light across the building.
A turn from dark to light across the whole building.

obraz: The bicycle left in the shed all year needs a repair before it will move.
proc: A thing left standing unused has lost its ability to move.
What is left standing unused loses its strength.

obraz: A drop has frozen at the tip of an icicle, just before it falls.
proc: A movement stopped and held at one point.
A moving drop is stopped and held as it is.

obraz: You keep looking at the same patch of ceiling before any leak appears.
proc: Something hidden is sensed before there is any evidence.
Something is sensed before it can be explained or seen.

obraz: You bring a dish to the shared dinner and go home carrying someone else's.
proc: Giving and receiving between people, uncounted.
Something leaves one hand and something is received, uncounted.

obraz: You open the curtains and can finally read the colour on the sample card.
proc: Daylight simply shines in and lets one see truly.
Sunlight simply shines and lets you see truly.

obraz: The jar lid will not move until you put your full grip behind it.
proc: Resistance yields only to full bodily force.
Resistance gives way to full bodily force.

obraz: The lift stops between floors, and everyone inside falls quiet.
proc: Movement stops and everything is held still.
Movement stops and everything is held still.

obraz: The dough rests under a tea towel, and by morning it has doubled.
proc: Covered and left alone, it completes itself within.
Covered and left alone, it completes itself within.

obraz: The borrowed dish comes back with something baked in it.
proc: A lent thing returns with a gift in it, exchange between two.
A gift returned between two sides, more than was owed.

obraz: Everyone agrees the mistake should be reported, and you put your name on the form.
proc: One person takes the stand personally and bears its cost.
You take the side knowingly and bear the cost under your own name.

obraz: The packed suitcase will not lift until you bend your knees and take its weight.
proc: A weight gives way once the body's strength is engaged.
A weight yields only to full bodily strength.

obraz: The sapling you planted by the bench now shades the place where you sit.
proc: What was planted long ago shows its result in its own time.
Something done long ago has ripened into a result.

obraz: The file downloads overnight while the screen shows nothing happening.
proc: Outside nothing seems to happen while it completes within.
Nothing shows outside while something completes itself within.

obraz: One friend brings the coffees, and the other has kept a seat.
proc: Each side gives something to the other, uncounted.
Each side gives something to the other without counting.

obraz: You tell the referee the ball was out, and your own team loses the point.
proc: Telling the truth knowingly at one's own side's cost.
Keeping to the truth and paying the price for it.
